question: What do onset-aligned FFT and wavelet measurements of one recorded open E2 and one GA-engine E2 establish before using offline ComfyUI candidates to refine the guitar WASM engine?
production_path: investigation: observe hypothesize test conclude reflect
synthesis_pipeline: excitation string_model body_resonance effects_chain output_stage
hypothesis: An onset-aligned local FFT can establish specific pitch and partial differences, while frequency-dependent wavelet tracks expose changes in the partial envelopes; neither alone validates realism, and a ComfyUI candidate must be separately versioned and listened to before guiding a GA WASM parameter change.
evidence: GA commit dc2e74cbd992a298f67efb928b5b3754615e1924: Rust/guitar-web-wasm-demo/rust-engine/src/lib.rs contains the procedural guitar engine; src/audio/audioEngine.js loads its WASM build in an AudioWorklet; full-auto.ps1 records and analyzes browser output with optional DDSP, not ComfyUI.
